hero.title: Core Capabilities & Self-Healing Loop
hero.subtitle: Your Kubernetes infrastructure is protected 24/7 through a 6-stage autonomous workflow: from instant detection, AI forecasting, root-cause diagnostics to controlled self-healing under human authority.

lifecycle.title: 6 Pillars of Autonomous Infrastructure Operations
lifecycle.desc: Engineered around the MAPE-K control loop (Monitor - Analyze - Plan - Execute - Knowledge) purposefully tailored for SME engineering teams.

detect.title: Infrastructure Radar & Instant Telemetry Collection
detect.desc: Continuously captures ultra-low-latency telemetry (< 1.2ms) via eBPF kernel probes and Prometheus scrapers. 10-second radar sweeps immediately surface Pod, Node, and network bottlenecks without degrading cluster performance.
bullets: Captures 100% of CPU saturation, RAM RSS, Disk I/O, and Ingress latency signals.
One-way outbound TLS streaming architecture (zero open inbound ports).
Full compatibility across EKS, GKE, AKS, K3s, and bare-metal kubeadm clusters.

predict.title: 15–30 Minute Early Degradation Forecasting via GRU Models
predict.desc: GRU (Gated Recurrent Unit) time-series neural networks continuously track hundreds of telemetry parameters, catching degradation trajectories well before OOMKilled crashes or CPU throttling hit.
predict.cardMsg: Resource degradation forecast: OOMKilled risk in 14m 20s (94.6% confidence)
bullets: Forecasts memory leak slopes and request queue saturation early.
Adaptive noise filtering eliminates false positives from transient network blips.
Continuously updated risk scores maintaining > 94% prediction confidence.

diagnose.title: Automated Multi-Dimensional Root-Cause Analysis (RCA)
diagnose.desc: Instead of combing through thousands of distributed log lines, the RCA engine correlates Kubernetes events (CrashLoopBackOff, Evicted), container exit codes (Exit Code 137/1), and GitOps drift to isolate the single root culprit.
diagnose.cardMsg: Root cause isolated: Container ExitCode 137 in checkout-service (98.4%)
bullets: Pinpoints the faulty microservice accurately on a causal dependency DAG.
Extracts contextual failure traces from container stderr and CoreDNS telemetry.
Delivers diagnostic Confidence Scores paired with targeted remediation options.

verify.title: Kubernetes YAML Diff Preview & Safe Approval (HITL)
verify.desc: Core principle: AI Proposes — Humans Decide — Agent Executes. Sensitive infrastructure mutations display Before vs After YAML diffs and blast radius estimates, requiring explicit engineer sign-off before execution.
verify.cardMsg: Human approval required before patching Memory: 256Mi → 512Mi
bullets: Visual resource diff previews (Resource limits, Replicas, Cordon).
One-click approval right from the Web Console or Slack/Teams webhooks.
Dual Operator Sign-Off mode for mission-critical Production clusters.

recover.title: Sub-2-Second Zero-Downtime Autonomous Recovery
recover.desc: Once approved or matched against policy guardrails, the Kubernetes Agent orchestrator executes safe actions via the Kubernetes API: gracefully restarting Pods, scaling replicas, or rolling back faulty releases.
recover.cardMsg: Self-healing completed in 1.8s: New Replica ready with zero disruption
bullets: Spins up healthy Pods cleanly before terminating failing instances (Rolling Replacement).
Auto-rollbacks to the latest stable ReplicaSet if a bad rollout triggers crash loops.
Reclaims resources swiftly from orphaned pods and memory cache leaks.

audit.title: Hardened Cluster Security & Immutable Audit Trails
audit.desc: SelfHeal is secure by design under Least Privilege principles. The K8s Agent never requires cluster-admin access, and every recovery action is cryptographically hashed and stored in an immutable PostgreSQL audit log.
audit.cardMsg: Immutable audit entry: SHA-256 signed & verified by sre_operator
bullets: Multi-factor identity security and scoped cryptographic tokens per cluster.
Tamper-evident audit logs capturing User ID, source IP, action, and YAML diffs.
Strict RBAC enforcement separating Owner, SRE Operator, and Auditor roles.

cta.headline: Ready to rethink infrastructure reliability?
cta.desc: Discover how SelfHeal helps teams monitor, forecast risks, and recover Kubernetes clusters proactively.
